response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT s.riskeval AS r, SUM(c.gbsize) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(c.spanmin), 0) AS rate FROM scans c JOIN sites s ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.riskeval), b AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS bench FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(g.rate - b.bench) AS avg_excess FROM g CROSS JOIN b WHERE g.rate > b.bench
